profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at HealthLevel
profile.summary:
6+ years of Software development experience in developing various enterprise web and Cloud application with Java, REST API Development, AJAX, Node.JS, HTML5, CSS, NoSQL(MongoDB), C#, MS SQL Server, PHP/MySQL.

Hands on experience with Big Data Eco-System and Distributed Computing.

Open Source follower

I have experienced all areas of software development from requirement analysis through to  implementation-testing and from initial customer negotiation to a tested, documented product delivery.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As an early engineer in the company, I have technical ownership of all HealthLevel products which includes expanding product features based on customer feedback, market requirements and to overcome any architectural challenges for integrating the same within existing and new customers.

- Built real time cache to speed up product performance.
- Built System wide notification System to keep customer informed for the reports they wish to see
  everyday, weekly or monthly and integrated same with all the products.
- Responsible to maintain data pipeline (ETL) for core database engine. Built various store  
  procedures in the system to achieve complex analytics reports.
- Built RESTful APIs that enabled other products to collaborate with each other and expanded
  product platform from web only to Mobile platforms.
- Maintaining and developing new features in the Continuous Integration System to speed up 
  development and release cycles with sanity checks during releases using Python, Jenkins,S3.
- Responsible for production release and technical support afterwards by providing hotfixes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed spring Java module for NICE’s Performance Management Suite and administrative tool to automate application installation with custom configuration on multiple server nodes with one click.

Fixed various bugs in the system while working on the main project.

positions.title: Co Founder and Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead Software Engineer at Pollence IT Services.

Managed team of 10 Software Developers who were working on various projects simultaneously.

Implemented many eCommerce Stores with Payment Gateway and Custom extensions to expand eCommerce footprint of the company.

Hands on experience with all areas of software development from requirement analysis to  implementation and testing to a well managed product deployments.
